name: 花怨鳗
evolution: 花怨鳗 → 鳗尾兽 Lv.26
description: 它们的身体具有趋触性，身躯底部会紧贴赖以生存的土地，这让它们有安全感，尤其喜欢湿润的泥土。三朵花常相互缠绕以保持接触，但也因此容易打结。当它们争执时，会发出连绵的铃声。
descriptionEn: Their bodies are thigmotropic, with the base of their bodies clinging tightly to the earth they depend on for survival, which gives them a sense of security; they especially like moist soil. The three flowers often entwine to maintain contact, but this also makes them prone to tangling. When they quarrel, they emit continuous bell sounds.
